symptom: Repair v23 split the v22 210-300s frosting-grassland Boss-after window into 210-255s and 255-300s segments, then shifted only 0.01 weight from sandwich-cookie-creep to sprinkle-spitter in the 255-300s segment. It passed partial candidate validation, materialization, full-pack preflight, static balance budget, schema contract, GameCore validate-content, isolated validate-candidates, and the 300s / 3-seed all-Bot smoke matrix. The 300s / 10-seed expansion still failed because GreedyXpBot remained at 60.0%, above the required 25%-55% mid-skill target. Idle 0.0%, Random 0.0%, Coward 20.0%, Kite 70.0%, Tank 50.0%, BossHunter 50.0%, ZoneControl 30.0%, and Route 30.0% stayed inside their target bands.
root_cause: The v23 change was too late and too small to affect the deciding Greedy outcomes. Greedy loss seeds still died around 225-232s, while the six Greedy victory seeds survived to 300s with the same victory count as v22. A 255-300s only weight transfer preserves other Bot gates, but it does not meaningfully challenge Greedy once rainbow-candy-shot and a small safety/economy/summon support package are already online. The result confirms that a post-255 sprinkle-spitter nudge is not enough to convert one Greedy victory into a defeat.
fix: Do not promote v23 into validated_candidates, simulated_candidates, playtest_candidates, accepted_content, or Runtime content. Create v24 as another generated candidate. The next repair should either move the narrow pressure earlier into the 225-255s decision window, or target the late safety payoff more directly through route/economy/buildcraft reward timing. Avoid broad weapon nerfs, early pickup cuts, or a blanket 210-300s ranged-pressure increase because prior probes showed those directions can break Coward, Route, BossHunter, or the player-facing build feel.
validation: Rerun the full candidate static chain, 300s / 3-seed all-Bot smoke matrix, and 300s / 10-seed all-Bot expansion. A viable v24 must keep Coward and Route between 10%-35%, Greedy / Tank / ZoneControl between 25%-55%, Kite / BossHunter between 45%-75%, and Idle / Random inside their floor bands before Replay regression, design review, manual playtest, or final acceptance evidence can be claimed.
